notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's names writer has three ask-once queries: CMSG_NAME_QUERY (full guid), CMSG_CREATURE_QUERY (entry+guid), CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY (pet number+guid). MSUI implements the first two with their SMSG responses handled; the pet-name pair is absent.
